messages:
sam: quick question — PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8421|#8421> touches both `runtime/kvcache/` and the top-level `CODEOWNERS`. who should sign off on the CODEOWNERS edit? it's a tiny tweak to add a fallback owner for /runtime, but i don't want to break approval routing.
kevin: can you paste the diff? if CODEOWNERS changes we usually need platform-owners or a cross-team signoff, right?
sam: paste of the relevant hunks:
```
# in CODEOWNERS
/runtime/ @infra-ml
/ops/ @infra
+ /runtime/kvcache @infra-ml @platform-owners
```
and PR also updates `runtime/kvcache/cache.go` with a small rename.
jen: fwiw policy: edits to CODEOWNERS require approval from at least one explicit owner listed in the file and one member of `platform-owners` if the change affects approval routing. that's how we avoid silent takeover. :thinking:
codeowners-bot: PR #8421 — status: merge-blocked — missing approvals from `@platform-owners` for CODEOWNERS modification.
maria: If it's just a fallback add, could we instead scope the change to only the runtime dir and have the runtime owner approve? i.e., limit the CODEOWNERS change to `/runtime/kvcache` not the top-level file touch that broadens globs.
alice: platform-owners here — we try not to rubber-stamp changes to CODEOWNERS unless there's a clear justification. if the intent is to add `@platform-owners` as co-owner we need a short rationale in the PR (security/approval routing reason).
kevin: i'm oncall and can help unblock small fixes, but i'm not in `platform-owners`. if sam adds the justification i'll escalate to alice for quick review. also CI looks green earlier but let's wait for the latest run.
sam: ok adding a short rationale: "fallback owner so vendor runtime changes have a clear approver when infra-ml is OOO; no behavior changes." will also restrict the hunk to only `/runtime/kvcache` line.
jen: sounds reasonable. tagging @alice for a one-off approval — alice, would you mind a quick look? i marked it `needs-platform-approval` label.
alice: looked — change is small and justification is OK. i'll +1 the CODEOWNERS hunk but please avoid broadening globs next time. leaving an approving review now.
codeowners-bot: PR #8421 — platform-owners approval received (alice). merge-block lifted pending normal owner approval.
kevin: thanks — i can leave the runtime code review and then merge once you add the `proxy-approved` label, sam.
sam: added `proxy-approved` and a short PR comment linking to this thread. thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
maria: can we add a follow-up task to audit patterns under `/runtime`? small patterns creeping into CODEOWNERS are easy to miss.
jen: yes — filing a quick ticket and assigning to infra-ml for a cleanup in two weeks.
sam: merging in 5 once CI finishes. thx everyone!
